task: A warehouse has 500 boxes. It ships out 15% on Monday and 40 more on Tuesday. How many boxes remain?
A bakery made 360 cupcakes. They sold 20% in the morning, then another 50 cupcakes in the afternoon. How many cupcakes are left?
A bookstore had 720 books. It discounted 10% of them and sold those, then sold another 80 books at full price. How many books remain?
A garden had 150 rose bushes. 18% died over winter, and the gardener planted 25 new bushes afterward. How many rose bushes are now in the garden?
A school library contains 1,200 novels. During a reading week, 5% were borrowed, and then an additional 90 novels were taken out for a class project. How many novels are still on the shelves?
A factory produced 2,400 gadgets. It shipped 7% to overseas clients, then sent another 180 gadgets to a local distributor. How many gadgets remain in the factory?
A charity collected 850 cans of food. They donated 12% to a shelter, then gave another 95 cans to a community pantry. How many cans are left for future distribution?
A zoo has 600 penguins. 9% were transferred to another zoo, and then 40 penguins were relocated to a new exhibit. How many penguins remain in the original habitat?
A cinema sold 1,500 tickets for a weekend. On Saturday, 22% of tickets were sold, and on Sunday they sold another 280 tickets. How many tickets remained unsold?
A farmer harvested 3,200 kilograms of tomatoes. He sold 15% at the market, then an additional 400 kilograms to a restaurant. How many kilograms of tomatoes are left?
A bakery made 360 croissants. They sold 20% in the morning, then another 45 croissants in the afternoon. How many croissants are left?
A library has 1,250 books. It discards 8% due to damage, then receives a donation of 120 books. How many books does the library have now?
A concert hall seats 2,800 people. On the first day, it sold tickets for 35% of the seats. The next day, it sold 540 more tickets. How many seats remain unsold?
A garden has 500 tomato plants. Twelve percent wilted during a heatwave, and the gardener transplanted 30 new seedlings. How many tomato plants are now in the garden?
A school bus can hold 60 students. In the morning, 45% of the seats are filled. Later, 8 students board the bus. How many empty seats are left?

A tech store has 1,800 phones in inventory. They run a clearance sale reducing the price of 10% of the phones, and those phones are all sold. After the sale, they receive a shipment of 250 phones. How many phones are now in inventory?
A charity raised $4,500. They spent 18% on administrative costs, then donated 30% of the remaining amount to a project. How much money is left after these two expenditures?

A factory produced 2,400 widgets. Fifteen percent were defective and scrapped. The next week, they repaired 120 of the defective widgets and added them back to inventory. How many good widgets are now available?
A water tank holds 3,200 liters. On Monday, 25% of the water was used. On Tuesday, an additional 400 liters were used. What volume of water remains in the tank?

A marathon runner logged 150 kilometers over a month. She wants to increase her total distance by 20% next month. However, she plans to run 30 kilometers less than half of that target in the first half of the month, and the remaining distance in the second half. How many kilometers does she need to run in the second half of the month?
A bakery made 350 loaves of bread. It sold 20% of the loaves on Saturday and then sold 45 more loaves on Sunday. How many loaves remain?
A library has 1,200 books. It discards 5% of the books due to damage, then purchases 180 new books. How many books does the library have now?
A fundraiser collected $8,500. It used 12% of the funds for advertising and then donated $2,300 to charity. How much money remains after these expenses?
A school starts the year with 480 students. 15% of the students transferred to another school, and then 30 new students enrolled. How many students are now enrolled?
A warehouse stored 750 boxes. 8% of the boxes were broken and removed, and then 120 more boxes arrived. How many boxes are now in the warehouse?
A theater sold 1,200 tickets. 10% of the tickets were discounted tickets, each costing $5 less than the regular price of $20. What is the total revenue from ticket sales?
A garden had 640 plants. Over the winter, 25% of the plants died, and the gardener then transplanted 80 new seedlings. How many plants are in the garden now?
A company had 1,500 units in inventory. It sold 18% of the units in the first month and then returned 50 defective units to the supplier. How many units are left in inventory?
A charity collected 3,200 cans of food. 7% of the cans were spoiled and thrown away, and then the charity received a donation of 250 more cans. How many usable cans does the charity now have?
A soccer league has 48 teams. If each team plays every other team exactly once, how many total matches will be played in the season?

A school fundraiser raised $1,200. They spent 25% of the money on decorations and then $150 on printing. How much money is left for the charity?

A garden has 1,200 tulip bulbs. 22% sprouted in the first week, and of the remaining bulbs, 180 died. How many tulip bulbs are still alive?

A factory produced 2,500 widgets. They were packaged in boxes of 25 each, but 4% of the widgets were defective and removed before packaging. How many full boxes can be made with the non-defective widgets?

A charity received 1,640 canned goods. They distributed 30% to a local shelter, and then they gave away another 200 to another organization. How many cans are left?
A software company has 1,800 active users. In a month, 12% unsubscribed, and then they gained 250 new users. How many active users are there now?

A train can carry 960 passengers. On the first leg of its journey, it was at 85% capacity. At the next stop, 40 passengers got off and 30 new passengers boarded. How many passengers are on the train now?
